title: sparganium × oocarpum
intro: Sparganium × oocarpum, commonly known as the hybrid bur-reed or hybrid sparrow's tail, is a rare aquatic plant resulting from the cross between Sparganium emersum and Sparganium erectum. The health benefits of Sparganium × oocarpum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and treat various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Sparganium × oocarpum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
